notes.title: Post-launch Update!
notes.content:
Check out what's new in Journey to Monolith's first post-launch update!

[h1]New Units[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44797047/4eb4ac5f6f0a44dc7d5e11a8a72f3b633bdafe3c.gif[/img]
[b]Silverguard Knight[/b]
This LYONAR support unit boasts a decent DEFENSE stat and immediately gives a temporary boost to your leading fighter's ATTACK stat with its ability [i]Rallying Charge[/i] at the start of Combat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44797047/12f3950bb5e675beec2d2c719d96bf371cf89f70.gif[/img]
[b]Silithar Egg[/b]
Nurse this defenseless MAGMAR egg through a handful of turns during Combat, and it will evolve into a Young Silithar!  Once it hatches it's ready to fight, but you can also keep it on the backline until it evolves again... and again!  Keep it safe by powering up its HP or ARMOR stat, or pair it with attacks like [i]Overgrowth[/i] to accelerate its growth.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44797047/621592b5266f525026491dab6c7c834d3b17ce89.gif[/img]
[b]Snowchaser[/b]
The new VANAR fighter doesn't have a lot of DEFENSE or HP, but its ability [i]Shielded Entry[/i], gives it some ARMOR each time it switches in.  Use that extra staying power to lauch support moves like [i]Protective Field[/i], [i]Weapon Lock[/i], or [i]Icestorm[/i].


[h1]New Enemies[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44797047/fe253865a571b902e92bbe72106dc2316d7e7065.gif[/img]
[b]Silvertongue Corsair[/b]
Watch out for this pirate's ability, [i]Fight Dirty[/i], which gives a temporary debuff to your active unit's ATTACK stat when it switches in.  Hopefully you aren't putting all your eggs in one basket and can switch out to remove the stat drop!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44797047/65daef5c1b81333f4d4e1a211142e14170764e00.gif[/img]
[b]Deathblighter[/b]
This dangerous cat serves as a hard-counter to strategies centering around Mini-Jax - while it's still alive, it reduces the damage of ALL Mini-Jax to ZERO!  Good thing it doesn't have a ton of HP or DEFENSE, so once you get it in the active spot it should come down easily.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44797047/3fc872fff230fdd0c3d1e7408d2bffc86cec0542.gif[/img]
[b]Mirrorrim[/b]
If you like buffing up one strong fighter and then cleaning up, watch out for Mirrorrim!  When it switches in, its ability [i]Mirror Image[/i] copies the opposing unit's stats completely - try to take it down before you power up your end-game sweeper!

[h1]New Elite[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44797047/bd40ea45b5700e27e2c1e480e65f0a6e7729fced.gif[/img]
[b]Protector[/b]
You'll need to decent firepower to push through this Elite unit's high DEFENSE and ARMOR.  Thankfully it doesn't have much ATTACK power, but its ability [i]Regenerating Armor[/i] gives it more ARMOR between turns, so don't let it sit for too long or it will wear you down before you know it!

notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.content:
[b]- Updated UI (additional tooltips, progress bar updates, "switch" button rework[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44797047/f3fa97f5cff2c90899402bff3377c696f7351cef.png[/img]


[b]- New COMBAT LOG for easy reference during battle![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44797047/799c125a0a77afd1763e656da58a4d05879b8351.png[/img]

This new quality of life feature will show the last several turns of the battle, in case you missed what attack was used by the enemy, or want to show off that perfect switch to your friends.  Easily toggle-able on the right-hand side of the combat screen!


[b]- New early game enemy, the "Dragonlark"[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44797047/854aa04b1fcbf8e6940700a62b2b8783cdccb12d.gif[/img]

This fearless flyer has good speed and moderate attack, but not a ton of healthpoints or defense.  Take it out quickly before it can support its teammates with its Mayhem attack, which gives a random ally more Attack power!

notes.title: Demo Updated
notes.content:
The Demo has been updated with even more SPELLS!  Find amazing combos each run and build a powerful team to take you all the way to the Monolith!

[h2]Spell Archives[/h2]
As you navigate through each region, you may stumble upon the mysterious Spell Archives - an ancient chamber filled with unique tomes that can be purchased with your hard earned gold.

Each time you visit the Archives, you will be given the choice of three spells unique to the current region. Spells are powerful add-ons that become linked to whichever fighter you give it to, enhancing its powers in battle.  But be careful - many spells come with a significant side effect that you'll need to account for as you build your squad.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44797047/04ea34384b1c64086a506a203c8bd0d504e5d8a2.png[/img]

Here are some examples of the new Spells you may encounter on your Journey!

[h2]War Surge[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44797047/4dd1b6ea5a9e5826bf428bbb5024bb846d32d8bc.png[/img]

War Surge is a shining example of gaining some stats at the expense of another.  This defensive spell only triggers once per battle, but give a nice boost of ARMOR when it goes go off.  But watch out - your fighter's SPEED stat will drop as well!  Probably best to use on something that doesn't mind attacking last, or that wants just a [i]little[/i] more time to set up for a big attack.

[h2]Infernal Pact[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44797047/02d7caede38210739f87e5f9a718c107bb653e63.png[/img]

Similar to the one above, Infernal Pact is also a double-edged sword!  Immediately gain some extra survivability by boosting a unit's Hit Points (HP), but the "victim" will also become Poisoned as a result!  Maybe try to stick it on a fighter that can take advantage of being Poisoned, or with a Lyonar champion equipped with "Cleansing Strike" to remove the poison before it even does any damage.

[h2]Cyclone Mask[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44797047/505a3ebba846c3f6b2e95f2a772b3cad3eef96d5.png[/img]

Have a fighter that needs just a little extra speed in order to make it [i]really[/i] dangerous?  Experiment with giving it the Cyclone Mask for that bump in initiative!  Just be prepared for the additional damage to your other fighters each time it attacks!  Combo with an ally that likes being damaged, or keep your team size small to limit the negative effect of this Spell.
